origin: Codex 0.142.5 request that names an output limit of its own (max_output_tokens 2000: derived from the capture by adding the field), and an answer that runs out of tokens in the middle of its second call, the first of which is whole: the client is told the response is incomplete and is given no call, which it would run before it sent the request again.
